svg.text: Baseline kinematics: one servo on finger A, 1:1 spur sectors to finger B
Front view, jaw plane. Units mm. Solid = closed (theta 0); dashed = open (theta +20 deg). Geometry: params.json + DESIGN-BASIS D3.
H: wrist-roll horn face (4x M3 on Ø14 BC)
FSR + 1 mm backing on B (D7, D8)
a = 28 mm (m 1.5 z 19); x_f = 12.0; root 22; finger L 45
r_c = 65 mm (pivot to pad-normal line; D2/D3)
per-jaw tip stroke 23.6 mm; tip rise -0.07 mm open
pads tilt 20 deg each when open; parallel at theta 0
T_servo = 2 F r_c / eta: LC1 0.765, LC2 1.529 N*m
deadband 0.27 deg -> 0.31 mm at the pad
F per pad: 5 N target (R14), 10 N cap (R15)
